Vacancy.title: Vacancy
Vacancy.description: A job vacancy (vacature) published by the employer. Models the ADR-001 menu-6 'Onboarding & ATS' recruiting surface (recruiting-ats-basic): a declarative concept -> gepubliceerd -> gesloten publish lifecycle, no external multiposting (werk.nl/LinkedIn is an OpenConnector follow-up) and no public career page (portaliq per ADR-046). Applications reference this Vacancy via Application.vacancyId.

publiceren.description: The vacancy is published (inside hrmq only — no external channel wiring in the MVP). publishedDate is stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern).

sluiten.description: The vacancy is closed. Terminal — no re-open and no publish-from-closed edge; a closed vacancy is re-created, not resurrected.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department or team the vacancy belongs to.

status.title: Status
status.description: Publish workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gepubliceerd -> gesloten).

publishedDate.title: Published date
publishedDate.description: Date the vacancy was published, stamped on the publiceren carrying write.

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: Application deadline. Informational only in the MVP — it does not drive the sluiten transition.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Vacancy is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); a vacancy has no employee to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: A candidate's application (sollicitatie) against a Vacancy. Candidate PII (name/email/phone/CV/motivation) lives DIRECTLY on this object — there is deliberately no separate Candidate entity in the MVP (AVG data-minimisation, design D2): one object carries one retention clock (retentionExpiryDate) and one deletion (deleting the Application deletes the candidate's data atomically). The declarative pipeline lifecycle runs nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, with afwijzen reachable from every active stage. Rejecting an application stamps rejectedDate and derives retentionExpiryDate per the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn (4 weeks, or 1 year with explicit talentPoolOptIn consent) — enforced by the nl-ats-retentie-derivatie and nl-ats-retentie-verlopen checks (lib/Standards/Checks/NlAtsChecks.php, lib/Standards/rules/privacy.json). aannemen documents a MANUAL onboarding hand-off (creating the Employee from this data is a manual follow-up action in the MVP — no cross-object write hook).

uitnodigen.description: The candidate is invited for an interview. No calendar/scheduling integration in the MVP.

aanbieden.description: An offer is extended to the candidate. No offer-letter generation/e-signature in the MVP.

aannemen.description: The candidate is hired. Terminal. Onboarding hand-off is a MANUAL follow-up action in the MVP — HR creates the Employee/Onboarding case by hand from this application's data (the same deferral class as leave-balance auto-posting); no cross-object write hook fires here.

afwijzen.description: The candidate is rejected (or, absent a public career page and candidate actor, a withdrawal is also recorded this way by HR). Terminal. rejectedDate and retentionExpiryDate are stamped on the carrying write: retentionExpiryDate = rejectedDate + 4 weeks, or + 1 year with talentPoolOptIn consent (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn).

vacancyId.title: Vacancy
vacancyId.description: UUID reference to the Vacancy this application is for.

candidateName.title: Candidate name
candidateName.description: Full name of the candidate. Candidate PII lives on this object only (design D2) — deleting the Application deletes this data.

cvFile.title: CV file
cvFile.description: Reference (Nextcloud Files path or OpenRegister file id) to the uploaded CV, the Expense.receiptFile pattern.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pipeline status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (nieuw -> screening -> gesprek -> aanbod -> aangenomen, afwijzen reachable from every active stage).

rejectedDate.title: Rejected date
rejectedDate.description: Date the application was rejected, stamped on the afwijzen carrying write. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

talentPoolOptIn.title: Talent pool opt-in
talentPoolOptIn.description: Explicit candidate consent to extended talent-pool retention. Extends the retentionExpiryDate derivation from 4 weeks to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens maximum of 1 year.

retentionExpiryDate.title: Retention expiry date
retentionExpiryDate.description: Stored-but-rule-checked AVG retention deadline (design D4): rejectedDate + 4 weeks without talentPoolOptIn, or + 1 year with it (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens sollicitatie-richtlijn, AVG art. 5 lid 1 sub e). Checked by nl-ats-retentie-derivatie / nl-ats-retentie-verlopen. Null on every non-afgewezen status.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Application is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an Application has no employee (the candidate is not yet hired), so this is set from the vacancy's administratie when known, and nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.
